text:
mei: heads-up — q5-int8 reranker A/B shows -0.022 MRR on prod cohort B, but our local harness shows +0.18 MRR. weird pattern: failures on docs with language-tagged code fences (```python) and many short inline URLs with query params.
owen: can you paste a redacted example?
mei: sure, one fail (sanitized):
```text
query: "parse webhook payload in python"
doc_id: doc-9001
title: "Parsing webhooks"
body_md: "## Examples\n```python\ndef handler(event):\n    payload = json.loads(event['body'])\n    return payload\n```\nMore info: see https://example.com/api?ref=abc&utm=1\n"
```
taylor: hmm. two leads: 1) serving concatenates title + body_md -> tokenizer splits code fence markers differently across tokenizer versions, changing tokenization alignment inside code which is very sparse signal for reranker; 2) we have a sequence-length bucketing threshold that switches kernels (fastpath vs fallback) at 1024 tokens — quantized model behaves slightly different on fallback path, causing rank swaps near decision boundaries.
mei: i reproduced locally when i enabled the fallback path by increasing the example soak (simulate long doc). with fallback, q5-int8 drops ~0.02 MRR. without fallback it matches.
owen: also check candidate pruning: prod prunes at top-k=100 earlier (post-encoder) while harness prunes after reranker scoring at k=200. that interacts with kernel selection because fewer candidates => shorter average sequence length.
bench-bot: CI job queued: reranker/q5-int8/code-fence-repro -> https://ci.internal/6167890001/jobs/77 :gear:
taylor: repro plan: 1) run harness with exact serving concat (title+body_md), tokenizer=v2.0, force kernel=fallback, topk=100 prune point pre-encoder; 2) add synthetic cohort `code-fence-with-urls.jsonl` mixing long code blocks and URL query params; 3) run paired bootstrap on that slice. command i used: 
```
./eval_harness --model reranker:q5-int8 \
  --cohort code-fence-with-urls.jsonl \
  --preproc=serving_concat_md --tokenizer=v2.0 \
  --kernel=fallback --prune-point=pre-encoder --topk=100 \
  --metrics mrr,ndcg --bootstrap=3000 --out=tmp/codefence_repro.json
```
mei: ran that, see -0.019 MRR (close to prod). setting `kernel=fastpath` or forcing body_text-only makes harness align with previous +0.18.
owen: short-term mitigation: canonicalize serving to prefer body_text (strip markdown/code fences) OR force kernel selection consistent across environments (prefer fastpath when possible) — first is lower risk.
taylor: long-term: add kernel-path and prune-point to model onboarding checklist + an automated check that runs harness with both kernel modes and both preproc variants (md/raw_text). also add a regression monitor on `code-fence-with-urls` slice (alert on MRR drop >0.01 over 15m).
mei: filing PR #1410 with harness cohort + tests. i'll also open infra ticket to expose kernel selector config to staging so we can test parity.
bench-bot: PR CI started -> https://ci.internal/6167890001/jobs/78 :white_check_mark:
owen: thanks all, i'll own the hotfix to prefer body_text in serving (canary 15m), taylor please add checklist items. :thumbsup:
